companion.lu_chenzhou.bio: A courier and mobile striker. Values independence and courage.
companion.bai_yan.bio: A former academy student who controls the field. Values discipline and learning.

ability.ambush_strike.desc: Strike from behind for more damage.
ability.couriers_shortcut.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, free): +3 movement this turn.

exploration.bamboo_pass.start.text: Morning mist hangs over Bamboo Pass. The path splits three ways: an old road, a stream, and a ridge trail.
exploration.bamboo_pass.old_road.text: Deep wheel ruts mark the old road. A traveling courier rests by the roadside, sizing you up. Farther on, muddy footprints crisscross the path.
You read the prints: armed men, heading for a camp.
The prints tangle and you circle back, tired.
exploration.bamboo_pass.courier.text: The courier introduces himself as Lu Chenzhou. He thinks you walk too slowly, but he is willing to talk.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.text: The stream runs clear. Something glints between the stones.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.search.su: Between the stones: half a water-stained letter and some herbs.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.search.fa: You slip into the stream and lose some strength.
exploration.bamboo_pass.ridge.text: The ridge is steep and windy. You haul yourself up and the valley opens below.
exploration.bamboo_pass.lookout.text: A camp hides in the valley below. A scholar-like young man copies notes at the cliff edge: Bai Yan.
exploration.bamboo_pass.camp_edge.text: You creep to the camp's edge. A few guards lounge against the stakes; supplies are stacked inside.
You find a supply ledger and pocket some loose silver.
The guards spot you and you flee. (The skirmish arrives in a later milestone.)
exploration.bamboo_pass.gate.text: At the pass's end stands an old gate, its lintel carved with faded marks.
exploration.bamboo_pass.end_plain.text: You pass the gate safely and the trek ends. Something in these hills is not finished yet.
exploration.bamboo_pass.end_wise.text: You read the marks: they point to someone behind the camp. You leave the pass carrying that secret.
exploration.bamboo_pass.desc: Mist-bound Bamboo Pass: three paths, each with its own encounters and clues.
explore.title: {name}
explore.ended: The trek is over and used one slot.

story.day1_intro.n1: Welcome to Jade Valley, young one. Bandits have their eyes on the pass, and we must get ready this month.
story.day1_intro.n2: Each week has two slots. Pick an activity; it costs stamina, and when you run low, rest.
story.day1_intro.n3: Choose your path of cultivation first. Every bit of training makes you stronger and changes how others see you.
story.day2_path.choose: A few days have passed. Time to choose your path.
story.day2_path.choose.fist: Follow The Way of the Mystic Fist
story.day2_path.choose.sword: Follow The Way of the Green Blade
story.day2_path.choose.rain: Follow The Way of Listening Rain
story.day2_path.choose.later: Let me think a little longer
story.day2_path.chosen: Your path is set. Each practice takes it deeper.
story.day2_path.done: You have already chosen your path. Good. Keep sharpening it.
story.day4_battle.n1: At dawn a villager stumbles into the valley: bandit scouts are raiding the foot of the mountain!
story.day4_battle.n2: Please, they are taking the whole village's food!
story.day4_battle.n2.together: Ask your companion to come along
story.day4_win.n1: Thank you! Without you the whole village would be lost.
story.day4_win.n2: The bandits will soon learn someone defends the valley. Use the next two weeks well.
story.day4_lose.n1: You were forced to retreat. The villagers are shaken and some are hurt.
story.day4_lose.n2: Do not lose heart. Defeat teaches too, but time is short.
story.day5_faction.n1: Three parties visit within the same week, each hoping you will stand with them.
story.day5_faction.n2: Your choice gives the valley something to lean on. Choose carefully.
story.day5_faction.n2.pavilion: Stand with the Herb Pavilion (Shen Qinghe)
story.day5_faction.n2.couriers: Stand with the Courier Road (Lu Chenzhou)
story.day5_faction.n2.scribes: Stand with the Scribes' Study (Bai Yan)
story.day6_prepare.n1: The bandit chief arrives soon. Prepare this week, or scout Bamboo Pass if you like. Exploring is optional.
story.day7_crisis.n1: The month is nearly over. The bandit chief's band has gathered at the pass, torches strung in a line.
story.day7_crisis.n2: Two slots remain this week. Use them well; once it ends comes the decisive fight.
story.crisis_final.n1: People of Jade Valley, hand over what you hide and I will spare you!
story.crisis_final.n1_saved: The villagers you saved stand behind you with torches. No one steps back.
story.crisis_final.n2: Night falls, and the decisive fight begins.
ending.valley_sage.title: The Sage of the Valley
ending.valley_sage.body: After the bandits scattered you did not leave Jade Valley. People tell of your technique and your heart, and your companions choose to walk at your side. Years on, children still hear about that night on rainy evenings.
ending.valley_guardian.title: Guardian of Jade Valley
ending.valley_guardian.body: The bandits withdrew, and the villagers you saved came with grain to thank you. You are not the best under heaven, but Jade Valley now has someone to guard it.
ending.lone_victor.title: The Lone Victor
ending.lone_victor.body: You drove off the bandit chief but could not keep the fishing village safe. The valley is grateful, and keeps its distance. Standing at the pass you learn that winning does not mean you are no longer alone.
ending.valley_falls.title: The Valley Falls
ending.valley_falls.body: Firelight swallowed the pass. You gave everything and still could not stop the bandits. But you lived, and led the others into the mountains. The story is not over; it only begins again another way.
ending.faction.pavilion: The Herb Pavilion keeps its sickbeds and furnaces behind you, and after this fight no one in the valley waits to die hungry.
ending.faction.couriers: The couriers carried word out of the mountains, and the name of Jade Valley travelled far on hoofbeats.
ending.faction.scribes: The scribes wrote these years into a book. Later someone reads your name by lamplight.
ending.faction.neutral: You favored no one, so every side is willing to keep a lamp lit for you.
ending.heading: Epilogue
pause.title: Paused
cult.result.new_week: A new week begins. Stamina restored by {amount}.
world.area.valley_village.name: Jade Valley Village
world.area.valley_village.desc: Chimney smoke, flagstones and neighbours: where every road begins.
world.area.valley_village.w1: You spend half an hour at the village gate listening to an old man's tales.
world.area.valley_village.w2: Children crowd round for a story at the market; a few coins find your hand.
world.area.valley_village.w3: A cup of hot tea at the stall lets you breathe.
world.area.river_bend.name: Dragon-Return Bend
world.area.river_bend.desc: The stream turns here, and the fish gather.
world.area.river_bend.w1: You gather a few fish stranded in the shallows.
world.area.river_bend.w2: The sound of water settles your mind.
world.area.herb_terraces.name: Herb Terraces
world.area.herb_terraces.desc: Terraced herb beds climb the slope, lushest in spring and summer.
world.area.herb_terraces.w1: You pick a handful of common herbs.
world.area.herb_terraces.w2: The steep path leaves your legs lighter.
world.area.old_shrine.name: Abandoned Mountain Shrine
world.area.old_shrine.desc: The incense died years ago, yet someone still comes and goes.
world.area.old_shrine.w1: The worn stele sets you thinking.
world.area.old_shrine.w2: You sit before the altar a while; your breathing evens out.
world.area.ferry_dock.name: Linjiang Ferry Dock
world.area.ferry_dock.desc: The ferry out of the valley, where news arrives faster than boats.
world.area.ferry_dock.w1: The boatman tells you a few tales of the jianghu.
world.area.ferry_dock.w2: You help carry some cargo and are paid.
event.f_aftermath.1: Two days after the raid the village gate still smells of smoke, and everyone quietly clears the wreckage.
event.f_aftermath.2: "Those were no ordinary bandits," Elder Mo says quietly. "Their blades had schooling. This is not over."
event.f_aftermath.3: I nod and keep the words close.
event.f_gossip.1: "Heard? When they pulled back they went up the rear hill. There've been lights at the shrine at night."
event.f_gossip.2: The shrine… abandoned for years. Worth a look.
event.f_shrine_first.1: Fresh footprints cross the dust before the altar, and two shady figures crouch in a corner.
event.f_shrine_first.c.sneak: Slip away and note what they say
event.f_spring_fair.1: The spring fair opens; coloured cords hang across the lane and traders have come from the next town.
event.f_spring_fair.2: "Come have a bowl of hot soup and share the cheer!"
event.f_spring_fair.3: I help set up stalls all afternoon and come away well paid.
event.f_herb_lesson.1: "Gathering herbs is not weeding," Elder Mo says, crouching. "Know the root, read the season, leave the seed. Those are the rules."
event.f_ferry_rumor.1: The old ferryman lowers his voice: "The ringleader of the shrine crowd rode my boat, headed toward Cangwu."
event.r_village_chat.1: "They say it's rough outside the valley. Take your training seriously."
event.r_village_chat.2: I smile and agree, but the words stick.
event.r_herb_find.1: A rare herb grows bright in a rock crevice.
event.r_fish_tale.1: An old fisherman hands you half a grilled fish: "Young one, the fish are strong where the water runs fast."
event.r_bandit_stray.1: "Halt! Leave your coins!" A straggling bandit leaps from the reeds.
event.r_shrine_dream.1: You doze by the broken wall and dream of an armoured swordsman drilling in the courtyard.
event.r_shrine_dream.2: I wake with my palms oddly warm.
event.r_elder_lesson.1: "Watch the feet before you strike," Elder Mo remarks in passing, and you listen closely.
event.r_winter_frost.1: Frost lies thick as snow; villagers gather round the hearth and invite you to sit.
